steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Align configuration settings in app-meta.json for Creative Canvas.

steps.title: Establish Build Script Parameters
steps.description: Confirm root and app module build scripts target Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure system requirements, package namespace, and launch activity.

steps.title: Fix Layout Typo
steps.description: Correct the layout_width typo from 'match_match' to 'match_parent' in activity_main.xml to resolve the AAPT resource linking error.

steps.title: Declare and Initialize btnAboutBack
steps.description: Add the btnAboutBack button declaration and findViewByID call to avoid the NullPointerException on launch.

steps.title: Verify UI Components Initialization
steps.description: Ensure all buttons, image views and text overlays are properly bound to their resource layout IDs.

steps.title: Validate Art Filter Studio Logic
steps.description: Ensure the ColorMatrix filters apply mono, sepia, invert, and warm effects dynamically without crashes.

steps.title: Audit Sliding Puzzle Board Generator
steps.description: Confirm the 3x3 bitmap slicing and tile image view generation work flawlessly on different canvas bases.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Code Standards
steps.description: Check that no lambdas or stream APIs are used, maintaining full backward compatibility.

steps.title: Building Creative Canvas
steps.description: Compile, build and pack the entire package assets into a fully validated Android Debug APK with zero crashes.
